article.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
article.summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

all_candidates.summary: IFSとIFS Softeonは、倉庫向けAIの新機能「Fulfillment Flow」を発表した。6つの現場特化型AIエージェントが連携し、「部分最適のしわ寄せ」を解消する。同社 最高収益責任者（CRO）のメイリー氏へのインタビューを交え、あえてシステムを統合しない独自戦略や、保守的な日本の現場に適合するAIの姿と今後の展望をひもとく。

all_candidates.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
all_candidates.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.
